method: frontend type inspection (lib/v2.ts), backend route/service reads (api/v2_replay_routes.py, api/v2_replay_service.py, raceintel/race_state/race_state.py), live measurement (frame size, throughput)

endpoint_inventory.timeline: GET /v2/races/{id}/replay/timeline — metadata ONLY (race_id, frame_index, anchor ids/lap/time). Reconstruction-free. No flags, no pits, no laps.
endpoint_inventory.frame: GET /v2/races/{id}/replay/frames/{i} — full ReplayFrameResponse: frame meta + exact RaceState + leader_lap + checkpoint pointers. Only per-frame state source.
endpoint_inventory.no_digest_endpoint: no lighter per-frame summary exists; backend frozen, no new endpoints in D

candidate_classes.source: state.race_control.track_state (D9 contemporaneous TrackStatus token, exact per frame)
candidate_classes.timing: exact per-frame observation; first-observable-frame mapping is exact and causal

candidate_classes.source: state.race_control.last_message_category + last_message_flag (latest timestamped message lineage; text excluded upstream)
candidate_classes.timing: first frame where the (category,flag) pair appears; age field is derived-past-only, not used for mapping
candidate_classes.verdict: SUPPORTED (label = source pair only, never rewritten)

candidate_classes.timing: first frame where count increments = first frame the completed stop is observable
candidate_classes.verdict: SUPPORTED with narrow semantics: observed completion only (no entry/exit/in-pit phases in frontend data); no strategy inference

candidate_classes.source: top-level leader_lap per frame response (exact; may be null)
none in frontend frame data (no retirement/dnf field on DriverRaceState; backend explicitly performs no retirement inference)
candidate_classes.timing: not establishable causally; position-null + unobserved at race end is final-classification knowledge
candidate_classes.verdict: OMITTED — no backdating from final results (pathology P12 guard)

candidate_classes.source: none observed; spatial layer must not be presented as observed telemetry

corpus_strategy: per active race, fetch all frame states once (concurrency-limited, abortable, progress UI, module-level per-race cache); extract small digests (~0.5KB/frame); derive + memoize ordered index. Measured localhost throughput ~31 req/s single-client; one 1134-frame race ≈ 12MB. Feed/markers render when ready; track/order/timeline work immediately.
request_rules: historical read-only replay endpoints only; scoped to active race; no per-driver requests; no science endpoints
